approvalRequirement: The active A1-A3 goal requires a concrete proposal and approval for additional platform differences before counting them resolved.
approvalScope: Only the malformed UTF-32 surrogate replacement policy. It does not approve other codec, page, feature or study differences.
limitations: Independent decoder reference is standalone JDK 21 Charset, not Android SDK/OkHttp device instrumentation. Android source uses OkHttp ResponseBody.string().
Native decoder proof is historical and bound to exact signed sources. This turn ran only the current host harness while all phone tests are held.
One invalid UTF-32 surrogate case is directly verified. This does not prove every surrogate value, codec or malformed sequence.
Only the decoding function and fixture are byte-identical to the historical native source. The complete current product build has changed and is not claimed executed by that historical run.
P13 remains open for broader page, compression, provider, UI, lifecycle and accessibility verification.
proposal: Replace isolated surrogate values in fetched UTF-32 text with Unicode replacement character U+FFFD, preserving valid Swift Unicode text. Do not emulate the invalid scalar preserved by the standalone JDK reference.
